{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= OO

|descr= Validating the parameters of a certain method in a class.

|s1= [class,method,params] call [[BIS_fnc_validateParametersOO]]

|p1= class: [[String]] - class name

|p2= method: [[String]] - method used for validating (Taken from '''class >> "Methods"''')

|p3= params: [[Array]] - to be validated parameters

|r1= [[Boolean]] - validating flag

|x1= <sqf>["someClass","someMethod",[5,47,"test"]] call BIS_fnc_validateParametersOO;</sqf>
